notes.title: The Journey Towards Launch ⚔️
notes.content:
[h2]Commanders![/h2]

With every day, Izirians are getting stronger and taking over more land with the use of formidable magic. Are you ready to face them? The true war begins on [b]March 7, 2024[/b], at the launch day of Zoria: Age of Shattering ⚔️

Over the past month, we have been hard at work, focusing primarily on polishing and bug fixing. This phase of development is crucial as we want to deliver a seamless and immersive experience to you since day 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/4d6adf7420f4eb7693b683496dbaf6f53e841194.png[/img]
[i]Sometimes bug fixing feels like this.[/i]

Having said that, there have been additional matters that we are currently attending to. Do we have any achievement collectors in the audience? We've got great news for you 😉 We've been adding and testing [b]achievements[/b]! Hopefully, earning a new achievement will make you feel excited, regardless of whether or not you manage to "catch them all" 😃

In order to prepare you for the epic journey that awaits you in Zoria, we have released the Story Intro on YouTube. Feel free to check it out if you missed it by any chance!
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1159090/announcements/detail/3943531542798376441

What's more, last year we teamed up with DeepCool, a well-known company that makes computer cooling solutions, and recently, you could see the fruits of this collaboration! On January 16th, a new PC cooling system was launched, and we're incredibly happy with how it turned out 🎉
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1159090/view/3943531542794116451

Lastly, we've been polishing the [b]final, epic battle[/b] in the game. We aim to deliver a showdown that will leave you on the edge of your seats, making for a memorable conclusion to the adventures you had in Zoria: Age of Shattering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/f9ff436dfbb618e90976fec8c02d418868254366.png[/img]
[i]That's not an actual footage from the final boss fight. That would be a spoiler. [/i]

We're incredibly excited about the progress we've made and even more thrilled about what's to come. As we continue to fine-tune Zoria: Age of Shattering, we want to thank you for your unwavering support ❤️

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready for an epic adventure this March! Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ZoriaGame][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/k3fPxX8][b]Discord[/b][/url] if you haven't already 😉

Until next time,
Tiny Trinket Games
─────────────────────────────────────────────

notes.title: Major Improvements! 🤩 Monthly Changelog
notes.content:
[h2]Commanders! [/h2]

We're excited to share with you what's changed within this month in Zoria: Age of Shattering. We've implemented some elements you haven't seen before, as well as further improved features already in the game. Let's jump into it! 

[h2]⚔️ Speed Button During Encounter[/h2]
Say goodbye to long, drawn-out battles. With our new speed button, you can now control the pace of your encounters. This feature adds a new level of strategy and enjoyment to our turn-based combat system. Plus, we've added a handy marker on the turn queue, so you'll always know when the turn ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/4e010c5757dff2727441915996a85a2051185731.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ Combat Review[/h2]
Knowledge is power, and our new combat review feature gives you plenty of it. After each battle, you'll receive a summary, complete with EXP gained and any additional bonuses. And if you take on a new enemy, your journal will get updated with a new entry, which will be shown on-screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/e5e22fc466adc86cc10ad190fc8c4a7212c15e3e.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ Partial Voice Over[/h2]
We implemented a partial voice over that really breathes life into our characters. Now, characters will say the beginning of their dialogue lines, which adds a new layer of depth and personality. Hearing the voices of characters complements the storytelling aspect of Zoria, and makes them more real and dynamic. Soon, we'll show you what the voice overs actually sound like, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/11e3f2a7a926854c14d3200d280454d89a58e0b2.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ Map Improvements[/h2]
Navigation just got a whole lot easier. We added checkpoints to the map and made it more user-friendly, so you can focus on the adventure at hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/be33dcff6215f8c0ff0fdae7910e3d4a8cbce136.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ UI Improvements[/h2]
Finding and managing your equipment now should be a breeze. We touched up the equipment tab for better usability - new items will now be clearly marked, so you'll never miss a new addition to your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/1f9e7c8675221ce9d43b96d7adf34cbfa979afbb.png[/img]
[h2]⚔️ Overall Quality Improvements[/h2]
We worked on the overall quality of graphics in Zoria. From on-screen fonts and effects to the look of characters in and outside of cutscenes - the edges are visibly sharper. We also improved the journal with quests, making it more readable and easier to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/3b3c72cedbdc875812978321d74d419f9770b307.png[/img]
We hope you enjoy these updates as much as we enjoyed creating them. Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ZoriaGame][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/k3fPxX8][b]Discord[/b][/url] if you haven't already. Let's stay in touch! ⚔️  

Until next time,
Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: How to train a dragon? Asking for a friend.
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Commander! ⚔️[/h2]

[b]We understand that you are eagerly anticipating the Full Release date.[/b] Before we discuss the updates, we want to address this topic. We promise to announce the release date soon, but we're taking our time to ensure that we deliver a polished product that takes into account all factors that could impact the launch. [b]We appreciate your patience during this process[/b], and we are working hard to make sure that the final product is worth the wait.

Here are the latest updates to excite you for Zoria's upcoming release. 😃 Check out what we've got for you in this [b]Monthly Changelog #9[/b]!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/52515afea417ae9395f583be19c0603aeebd80ba.png[/img]

[h3]QA Testing [/h3]
We are in the final stretch of development before the release of Zoria: Age of Shattering. At this point, we are heavily focused on[b] quality assurance testing[/b] throughout the entire game. This process is essential to optimize the game and eliminate bugs or glitches. In addition, we have spent the past month testing and refining some [b]exciting new features that we have yet to reveal[/b], such as follower management and outpost upgrades. We can't wait for you to try them out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/9e75e344162b1c1dc629dbb1a1de1ffa1582b9c4.png[/img]
[i]A metaphor of us fighting bugs.[/i]

[h3]Content Lock [/h3]
We have finally achieved a significant milestone in game development - [b]the content lock[/b]. This is an important step where we decide that we won't add any more content to the game. This decision allows us to focus solely on refining and polishing the existing content. As you may know, it was not an easy decision because when you are creating something, there is always an inner critic that keeps telling you that you could do it better or differently. Many of you can probably relate to that feeling. 😅

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/70c85c1fb09fd4a745fa053c7119b3d85b54eedb.png[/img]
[i]My inner critic would never say "perfect" 😥[/i]

[h3]Intro Scene [/h3]
Recently, we have been working on creating a story-based introduction scene for the game. The goal is to introduce you to the game effortlessly despite the complicated circumstances you may find yourself in. 😉 [b]We're really pleased with the progress so far, and we hope you will enjoy it too![/b] As a sneak peek, here's a preview of what's in store:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/5bf4f02aadd43f7a78357bdd07cb5b36cd818d10.gif[/img]

[h3]Dragon[/h3]
We added a couple of events during which you will be able to interact with a [b]dragon[/b]. Beware! Despite its rather adorable demeanor, dragons found in the wild can and will hurt you. 🐲

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/bb47b192f6279bc67f85e438db6a226b3c4a4c52.jpg[/img]

[h3]Fun Videos[/h3]
Our publishing team had a lot of fun while creating short and funny videos that were inspired by Zoria. You can easily find them on Anshar Publishing's [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@ansharpublishing]TikTok[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@AnsharPublishing]YouTube[/url] channels. We believe that you may find them amusing and maybe even inspiring enough to create your own Zoria cosplay! 😃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/77488757a1afce59f6e29229f112b9a5494c6d39.jpg[/img]

As always, we appreciate your continuous support ❤️ Your enthusiasm for Zoria has been our driving force, and we aim to deliver a game that exceeds your expectations. Together, we'll embark on an unforgettable journey, and can't wait to share it with you!

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ZoriaGame]X/Twitter[/url] and join our Discord ⚔️

[url=https://discord.com/invite/k3fPxX8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d029a793af54184beabe368f4d69a5d886e66078.png[/img][/url]

Until next time,   
Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: Ready, Set, Upgrade! Monthly Changelog #8
notes.content:
[h1]Commanders! ⚔️[/h1] 

We're back with some updates to get you even more excited for Zoria's upcoming release. 😃 Check out what we've got for you in this Monthly Changelog #8!  

[h2]A bit of a Story Redesign  [/h2]

After consultations with an experienced and inspiring creative game director, we decided to [b]redesign parts of the game[/b] to make it more captivating for newcomers while retaining a fair amount of references to veterans who played the Prologue and the Demo. In other words – don't worry if you haven't played any of these; we made sure that the game will be a great stand-alone experience and that you'll embark on a wonderful adventure that will gradually unfold in front of you. 😊  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/ff5326dacb70209ec8f27deab06ae0abb9d58fb9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Outposts System  [/h2]

We've completed the Outposts! With Outpost System fully implemented, you'll be able to [b]rest and recover your followers[/b] in the cozy "Moon Flower" Burrow, [b]unleash your inner alchemist[/b] with the Black Cauldron, and [b]visit Blacksmith's workshop[/b] for the finest of items. The "Lucky Dog" Inn will be your go-to place for [b]thrilling quests and finding loyal companions[/b] to join your adventures. And yes, there will be an upgrade system that will allow you to enhance your outpost, but we're still figuring out the economy so that the rewards would be sufficient and satisfying – not broken. 😉  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/bd5103adbeae45bde8258f8d42041e1b04d354bd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Character Creator   [/h2]

We consider the highly anticipated Character Creator system as a "feature complete," giving you a lot of elements to play with to [b]customize your in-game persona[/b]. You'll be able to choose your gender, experiment with various hairstyles (including facial hair, such as beards and mustaches), and mix and match cloth and armor pieces to create your unique look. Tailor your character's body shape and proportions, and enhance their appearance with a wide range of tattoos, scars, makeup, and more. 🤩   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/f69926800ef6d733c9a8896ee8b838a815aaf22f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Polish  [/h2]

[b]We're just 70 days away from the big launch of our game! [/b]Our team is hard at work, polishing every aspect of the game to make sure everything runs smoothly. Your enthusiasm for Zoria have been our driving force, and we're aiming to deliver a game that exceeds your expectations. Together, we'll embark on an unforgettable journey, and we can't wait to share it with you!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/4f764a0463984e6c7f65bc0698c25f19badb5735.jpg[/img]

Follow us on Twitter and join our Discord to stay up to date with the latest news! ⚔️

[url=https://discord.com/invite/k3fPxX8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d029a793af54184beabe368f4d69a5d886e66078.png[/img][/url]

As always, we appreciate your continuous support ❤️

Until next time,   

Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: Full release on October 5th. Monthly Changelog #7
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Commanders![/h1]

Before we get to the changelog, let's share with you the latest decision we made.

[h2]Important Announcement[/h2]

[b]Due to the congested September release schedule, we chose to delay the release date of Zoria.[/b] Titles such as Baldur's Gate 3, Starfield, and Lies of P, to name just a few, release around the same period. While some of you have pointed it out as we announced our release date, we couldn't put Zoria, an indie game, and other AAA production titles, in the same league (but thanks to those of you who did, we took it as a huge compliment!). Long story short, we feel that shifting our release date would give Zoria the attention and exposure it deserves.

That said, we settled that [b]October 5th[/b] will be the best day to release Zoria: Age of Shattering. It's just a few days later than our initial release date, but we believe this time will provide a space between releases needed for Zoria to shine through. ☀️ Additionally, since every single day at this point will be extremely precious, it will give us extra time to polish the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/0c830a31173f7ec72116407516620d9bce007d9d.jpg[/img]

Now, let's see what's changed within the past month!

[h2]Monthly Changelog[/h2]

[h3]⚔️ Character Creator[/h3]
One of the significant improvements we've made in this category is [b]optimizing asset resource management[/b], which results in a lower memory footprint at runtime, ensuring smoother gameplay. 

We also [b]enhanced the customization options[/b]. Firstly, we improved support for colors, shader material modifications, and emissive materials. We even added a color picker! Secondly, we added a dynamic [b]size and scale control of the human body[/b]. Thanks to that feature, you'll be able to adjust body proportions and create different shapes of faces, making each character one-of-a-kind.

Furthermore, we implemented a wide array of styling features, such as various[b] hairstyles, faces, makeup options, eyebrows, facial hair[/b], etc., to ensure characters will come in a wide variety. Lastly, we incorporated numerous [b]new item models[/b] that can be used for character design, providing even more customization options. 

We started creating new NPCs using the updated character creator system, bringing more life and diversity to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/f541c4d775b4800f5aca04b2b3bacf31fe2a8cab.png[/img]

[h3]⚔️ Icon Generator[/h3]
We developed a useful tool for creating icons for in-game items. We're using it to create icons for all weapons and armor pieces in the inventory. We plan on using it to create portraits for heroes made with Character Creator as well, but we're still working on that 😉

Besides that, we're reworking and adjusting the [b]outposts [/b]to improve clarity and make them more intuitive. Some [b]new areas and dungeons[/b] have also emerged from the shadows, but we cannot talk too much about them to avoid spoiling anything. We're also waiting for the last two background [b]music pieces[/b], and Zoria's soundtrack will be complete! 😁 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/bd3946dc33c37d359b1b6152f09c218cd7498297.png[/img]

That's all for now, but stay tuned for more updates!

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ZoriaGame]Twitter[/url] and join our Discord ⚔️

[url=https://discord.com/invite/k3fPxX8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d029a793af54184beabe368f4d69a5d886e66078.png[/img][/url]

As always, we appreciate your continuous support ❤️

Until next time,
Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: Exotic armor, hiding trees, and the Lucky Dog Inn. Monthly Changelog #5
notes.content:
[h1]Commanders! ⚔️[/h1]

We're excited to share the latest update for Zoria: Age of Shattering. Our team has been working non-stop to bring you changes and improvements that'll make your gaming experience even better. This month we'd like to share what's new regarding camera & control systems, armor, outpost systems, and more! So, let's dive right in and see what's new 😁  

[h2]Camera and Controls  [/h2]
The camera will now have a [b]smoother motion[/b] and [b]auto-rotation[/b] toward the movement direction. Plus, we've added[b] alternative keyboard movement[/b] controls for those who prefer this control style to the mouse-click-only control. The camera collision system will work better now, and a new see-through camera obstruction feature will ensure an unobstructed view.  

Trees will no longer block your view! They will now disappear and won't block your sight 🌲👀  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/330efdccb0c3dd177e95e65748daaaa2b219606f.gif[/img]

[h2]Armor Tweaks  [/h2]
Armor changes will be visible on the 3D models of the main character and followers! We've also [b]categorized current armor sets[/b] into Light, Medium, Hardened, and Heavy, as well as by rarity: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Exotic, and Epic. We'll add even more armor designs in future updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/aba9aea71d4ba230863e4fe22a5b61b597367165.png[/img]

[h2]Outposts System  [/h2]
We've added a couple of new [b]outposts [/b]in the game, e.g., the "Lucky Dog Inn" and the "Moon Flower Burrow." The "Lucky Dog Inn" will be your go-to spot for quests and recruiting followers, while the "Moon Flower Burrow" will be perfect for resting and recovering 😊  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/abbc6701200d8344eb55b25187b6e65dacd60cc8.png[/img]

[h2]Difficulty Settings  [/h2]
There's a new system that will let you choose the difficulty of the game. This will affect things like [b]Enemy HP, Enemy stats influencing damage and resistances, and Enemy abilities[/b]. We decided on [b]three classic levels of gameplay difficulty[/b]: Easy, Normal, and Hard. Pick whichever suits you best!  


Additionally, Neles – Zoria's Producer and Quest Writer - is currently representing Tiny Trinket games at the [b]Reboot Develop Blue[/b] in Dubrovnik, meeting with other game developers, exchanging experiences, and of course, introducing Zoria to a new public 😊   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/1d417d7cc18fd1a177cf84a9a4b9cb0d66d751b7.png[/img]

Keep your fingers crossed for Neles, and as always, [b]follow Zoria on Twitter and Facebook, and join the Discord server[/b] to make sure you get all the latest updates and news from the world of Zoria! ⚔️

[url=https://discord.com/invite/k3fPxX8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d029a793af54184beabe368f4d69a5d886e66078.png[/img][/url]

Until next time!  
Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: Luring Dragons, Spawning Elementals, Counting Skulls. Monthly Changelog #2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Commander![/h1]

Working on Zoria: Age of Shattering is an [b]exciting[/b] but also [b]challenging[/b] experience. The ideas are endless, and expectations - yours and ours - are high. This month we introduced many valuable changes to the game. Are you ready? Welcome to [b]Monthly Changelog #2[/b]! ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/317b055d31d32918383f57710c9d3fcd342e7cd5.png[/img]
[i]A party ready to explore each corner. Do I smell... chest?![/i]

[h2]Remodeled and expanded locations[/h2]

Rithvale had a complete makeover. We needed to rebuild it to match it with our current level of quality. Rithvale will become your homebase and your safe haven you'll long for after a long journey. 

Players will now have quests available (both sidequests and main quests), making it a more[b] lively area worth revisiting at different stages of the game. [/b]

Do you remember Shrieking Pass? Some of you might have seen it in the demo from 2 years ago. We felt this location could be more interesting, so we decided to revisit it, with some new places and adventures ːsteamhappyː Now it is not only an area where the story takes place but also a part of the story on its own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/49dbdd63e06bb600173d0916c5c6d527ef4be3a2.png[/img]
[i]This is totally how we rebuilt our locations. We evacuate everyone, and then we lure a dragon and four Trolls to raze the city to the ground. Easy-peasy.[/i]

[h2]Attacks of Opportunity[/h2]

RPG players are most likely familiar with this system. Certain characters will be able to strike an enemy unit in combat as it moves next to them. It can be a very [b]satisfying[/b] move that'll prevent your opponents from running away from you and has a significant chance to finish them off without the need to chase them around the map (and possibly get into a trap).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/b63fcea7cee1ac627cfd67196287b48dfb292524.png[/img]
[i]These water elementals have yet to realize that they should be running away.[/i]

[h2]Character Creator[/h2]

Character Creator was a Strech Goal on Kickstarter that we unfortunatelly didn't reached [b]BUT[/b] we decided to add it after all. ːsteammockingː We believe that creating your own character in an RPG adds a lot of value to a roleplaying aspect of the game. Whether you like to adjust a gender or look to your own for a better immersion, play a hero of your dreams or make it an honor to play as a female character whenever possible - [b]we've got you.[/b]

Once again, huge thanks to everyone who supported us in the Kickstarter campaign!ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/fea9a90ae26d6849e8e11143412fed62385c104a.png[/img]
[i]There was a crowd waiting to witness your glory, but you took too long to pick up that perfect shade of hair (even though you can't see it through the helmet).[/i]

[h2]Best Upcoming - IndieDB Indie of the Year 2022[/h2]

Do you remember how last time we asked you to vote in a IndieDB's Indie of the Year poll...? 

[b]We got the 5th place!!! [/b]ːsteamhappyː

We knew there were a lot of you out there, yet getting this high in the rank exceeded our expectations! Thank you so much for voting! [b]It wouldn't be possible without your help[/b]ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: What's new in the world of Zoria? Monthly changelog.
notes.content:
Hello commanders! 

It's been almost a month and a half since our Kickstarter, and during this time, [b]we're working up a sweat to deliver the game that will give you a ton of fun.[/b] We want to introduce you to what we are currently developing and show you some new screenshots. We hope you enjoy them and whet your appetite for more! 

But before we get to the main course, we'd like to ask you to vote for Zoria in IndieDB's Indie of the Year poll. There are many of you out there, and we believe that together we will rank high in this competition for indie game lovers. 

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/zoria-age-of-shattering][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/070d9a93bf60633e767eed8a809110243b4bbfd7.jpg[/img][/url]

You can cast a vote on our IndieDB page [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/zoria-age-of-shattering]>>here<< [/url]

[b]Now, let's move on with the changelog.[/b]

[b][h3]Nightwarden Class[/h3][/b]
As some of you may recall, one of the secret goals of the Kickstarter campaign was reaching 50%, and it unlocked a new class - [b]fearless and violent Nightwarden[/b]. First, we had some rough ideas on how this class should act on the battlefield, and during the last month, we managed to finish the profile of this class.

Nightwardens [b]will use fire [/b]on the battlefield because this is the most effective deterring of monsters. Having Nightwarden in your team will significantly increase the group morale, as [b]Nightwardens fear no death[/b] and can teach their teammates how to act the same. On top of that, Nightwardens know that the night is short; therefore, [b]they must act quickly. [/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Tbwhbsn/Sequence-01.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Day-night cycle[/h3][/b]
Well, what would be the point of the existence of Nightwardens if there were no night, wasn't it? That's why we've been spending the last few weeks polishing the day and night cycle in the world of Zoria, which will not only limit the amount of sunlight but also [b]affect certain events and behaviors at specific times of the day.[/b] 

And remember, the world of Zoria is not a safe enough place during the day. I dread to think how it will be at night. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/93915a48baa4f2479e17f23caf1e3c518aa83b44.png[/img]

[b][h3]Lake Mannor[/h3][/b]
A castle in the middle of rocky mountains, a fisherman's hut, fog hovering over the lake, and rumors of a secret lurking beneath the surface of this reservoir. [b]Don't forget to chat with a hunter [/b]who stays in the area, as he will have something to say about the place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/be8af7db7561bac19c67085c8531cdf6aea06404.png[/img]

[b][h3]New enemy - Troll[/h3][/b]
What is it - it has two legs, pointy ears, smells horrible, and you wouldn't entrust your pet to its care? No, it's not a green-clad boy rescuing a princess. [b]It's a nasty troll lurking for fresh meat, [/b]inattentively straying near his lair. Just look at this monstrosity. It's probably time to show him that treating poor animals like this doesn't seem right. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d82af1487ef059090674bc53069b9c4c76b038c5.png[/img]

That's all for today, and we're back to making the game. Let us know what you think of the above features, and don't forget to join our Discord - it's a smug place for RPG & coffee lovers (but if you are more of a tea person, you are more than welcome too.) 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/k3fPxX8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/329fdb66137bcd2c299ca4d231619a03b531062d.png[/img][/url]

And if you haven't played the latest demo yet, be sure to test it out. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159090/Zoria_Age_of_Shattering/

Stay tuned,
Zoria Team

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - Let's talk about the Stats!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!👋

Today we want to talk about some [b]stats, armor, and attack types[/b] in Zoria. There are a lot of mechanics in the game that we believe we should cover, so you get the idea of what to expect when you jump into the world of Zoria. It's going to be a pretty long diary today, so grab your favorite beverage, snacks and enjoy the guide!

[b]Main Stats[/b]
These stats directly influence the character’s various attributes (health, damage) and the power of a character’s abilities.

 [list]
[*][i]Stamina:[/i] directly affects the character’s health. Especially important early game and the single greatest contributor to player survivability. 
[/list]
 [list]
[*][i]Strength:[/i] especially important for melee characters, directly affects Melee Attack Power and increases the Energy pool for Lancer class and Captain. It also increases block power for characters wearing a Shield.
[/list]
 [list]
[*][i]Agility:[/i] increases Ranged Attack Power for Ranger. Increases Melee Attack Power for Thief. Increases Melee Attack Power for Lancer, Kingsman, Battle Cleric, and Captain to a smaller degree. Increases Energy pool for Ranger, Thief, and Kingsman. Increases Crit Chance with values depending on the class. Increases Armor.
[/list]
 [list]
[*][i]Intellect:[/i] Increases Spell Power. Increases Magic Armor. Increases Crit Chance for magic abilities. Increases Mana pool for Wizard, Necromancer, Priest, Battle Cleric, Bard.
[/list]
 [list]
[*][i]Armor:[/i] reduces the amount of damage received from physical abilities and effects.
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Magic Armor:[/i] reduces the amount of damage received from magic abilities and effects.
[/list] 
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d352c0405c47997bd4541b02bc72e2d49892bb94.png[/img]

 
[b]Secondary Stats:[/b]
 [list]
[*][i]Initiative:[/i] it influences the character’s place in the combat queue at the start and where it will be placed in the queue once that character’s turn is finished. A character with a high Initiative value will be placed higher in the combat queue once its turn is completed than a character with a low Initiative value.
[/list]
 [list]
[*][i]Hit Chance:[/i] chance to hit with an ability. It is directly influenced by the level difference between the character and the enemy. The higher the level of an enemy compared to the character, the lower the Hit Chance.
[/list]
 [list]
[*][i]Crit Chance:[/i] Critical chance is influenced by the dominant stat for that class – Agility or Intellect.
[/list]

 
[b]Elemental Resistances:[/b]
All magic effects belong to a type of elemental magic.
 [list]
[*][i]Fire Magic[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Water Magic[/i]
[/list] 
 [list]
[*][i]Nature Magic[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Arcane Magic[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Death Magic[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Light Magic[/i]
[/list]
 
Light and Death Magic are in direct opposition, with Death Magic wielders being especially weak to Light Magic and Light Magic wielders especially weak to Death Magic abilities.
Enemies weak to Fire Magic are equally weak to physical Fire effects, like the Fire Arrow Ranger ability.
Elemental resistances mitigate a percent of the incoming damage from that specific element. Gear pieces with elemental resistance have values representing their elemental resistance. Depending on the level, these values translate to different percentages of elemental resistance, making a low-level gear piece more effective in elemental protection for the appropriate level character.

[b]Effects:[/b]
These effects are placed on the character by various abilities and can be temporary (only during combat) or permanent (must be removed by resting, using a potion, or in the Outpost). Each effect influences the player’s stats differently:

 [list]
[*][i]Sunder:[/i] can be applied by physical abilities. Decreases the player Armor and can stack multiple effects.
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Wound:[/i] can be applied by physical abilities. Decreases the player Initiative while active.
[/list] 
[list]
[*][i]Bleed:[/i] can be applied by physical abilities. Deals damage over time to the character until removed.
[/list] 
[list]
[*][i]Stun:[/i] can be applied by any kind of ability. Locks the character in the current position in the combat queue for its duration.
[/list] 
[list]
[*][i]Poison:[/i] can be applied by Nature abilities. Decreases Hit Chance.
[/list] 
[list]
[*][i]Disease:[/i] can be applied by Nature abilities. DecreasesAgilityandIntellect.
[/list] 
[list]
[*][i]Curse:[/i] can be applied by Death abilities. Decreases Strength and Magic Armor.
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/2f17367010ffd68b9e27e134a8e94fe65c84552c.png[/img]

These effects do not show on the Character Stat sheet but in the abilities description for each ability that places a certain effect. Some enemies can be immune to certain types of effects, making the abilities that place those effects less effective. This immunity will be shown in the Compendium entry for each enemy.

[b]Stats influence on abilities:[/b]
The power of each ability of a certain class is affected by the main stat. Because of this, different builds for a class can benefit from a different main stat.
 
As an example, below are some of the Kingsman’s abilities and the stats affecting their power:

[list]
[*][i]Strength:[/i] Basic Attack, Vanquish thy Foe, Avenger Strike, Bash of Wrath.
[/list] 
[list]
[*][i]Agility:[/i] Shield Wall, King's Resolve, Deflect, Hold the Line, Avatar of Protection.
[/list] 
[list]
[*][i]Intellect[/i]: Magic Absorption, King's Fire.
[/list]
 
[i]Fatigue:[/i] is a special stat central to the Fatigue and Outpost recovery mechanic. We will introduce more details on this mechanic in a dedicated post later.
 
Together with the Stats update, we are also introducing new stats to armor and weapons.

[list]
[*]Durability: all weapons and armor now have certain durability that decreases with each combat. Once a gear item’s durability reaches 0, that item is no longer usable and does not contribute to the character’s stats.
[/list]

[b]Armor Types:[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Light Armor[/i]: worn by Wizard, Necromancer, and Priest classes.
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Medium Armor:[/i] worn by Ranger, Thief, Bard classes, and the Captain.
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Hardened Armor:[/i] worn by the Ranger, Kingsman, Lancer, Battle Cleric classes, and the Captain.
[/list]
[list]
[*][i]Heavy Armor:[/i] worn by the Kingsman and Lancer classes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/c625f158f8acd6fcbda6978ec466ee9f3b103fb7.png[/img]
 
[b]Weapon Damage and Spell Damage:[/b]
[list]
[*]All weapons now have a weapon damage stat. This damage is added to the base attack of the character using that weapon.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Specific caster weapons, like the staff, have a Spell Damage stat instead of Weapon Damage.
[/list]

Stay tuned for future updates, as there is much more we want to present to you!

Cheers,
Team Zoria

[url=http://bit.ly/ZoriaKickstarter][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/34298a2a31aa42ec44dd612837a81cbd9a1669f6.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog: Stats
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers of Zoria,

We’ve had a busy couple of months with the release of the Prologue and the Steam Summer Festival, going through all the awesome feedback we have received from you and updating and improving the Prologue based on that feedback.
With Prologue update 0.3.5 launched and all that behind us now, we are moving towards finalizing development for the features that are still missing and adding content for the game.

For today’s Devlog we will make an in-depth presentation of the updated stats system and its influence on skills and items in the game. We will not be discussing exact numbers since game balance is still ongoing and many of these numbers will probably be adjusted several times before release, but the workings of the system remain in place.

First thing to mention, we are renaming some stats that proved to be confusing for a lot of players to be more in-line with classic RPG players expectations.
[list]
[*] [b]Mastery[/b] becomes [b]Strength[/b]
[*] [b]Prowess[/b] is now more properly named [b]Agility[/b]
[*] [b]Speed[/b] is now [b]Initiative[/b], to better illustrate its role in the combat queue.
[/list]

Together with the new Stats we are introducing several new concepts:
[list]
[*] [b]Melee Attack Power[/b]
[*] [b]Ranged Attack Power [/b]
[*] [b]Spell Power [/b]
[*] [b]Block Power[/b]
[/list]

Every ability’s power is influenced by one of these 3 values, and each of these values is directly influenced by a Main Stat.

Block power only applies to characters wearing a shield and mitigates a percentage of the damage received depending on the Block Power of that character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/4d4071ef9e10513a3daad7d9d233f8fe0bbdd4ea.png[/img]

With all this said, character stats now look like this:

[b]Main Stats[/b]

These stats directly influence the character’s various attributes (health, damage) and the power of a character’s individual abilities.
[list]
[*] [b]Stamina:[/b] directly affects the character’s health. Especially important early game and the single greatest contributor to player survivability.
[*] [b]Strength:[/b] especially important for melee characters, directly affects Melee Attack Power and increases the Energy pool for Lancer class and Captain. Also increases block power for characters wearing a Shield.
[*] [b]Agility:[/b] increases Ranged Attack Power for Ranger. Increases Melee Attack Power for Thief. Increases Melee Attack Power for Lancer, Kingsman, Battle Cleric and Captain, to a smaller degree. Increases Energy pool for Ranger, Thief, Kingsman. Increases Crit Chance with values depending on class. Increases Armor.
[*] [b]Intellect:[/b] Increases Spell Power.  Increases Magic Armor. Increases Crit Chance for magic abilities. Increases Mana pool for Wizard, Necromancer, Priest, Battle Cleric, Bard.
[*] [b]Armor:[/b] reduces the amount of damage received from physical abilities and effects.
[*] [b]Magic Armor:[/b] reduces the amount of damage received from magic abilities and effects.
[/list]

[b]Secondary Stats:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Initiative:[/b] it influences the character’s place in the combat queue at the start of the combat as well as the place it will be placed in the queue once that character’s turn is finished. A character with a high Initiative value will be placed higher in the combat queue, once its turn is completed, than a character with a low Initiative value. 
[*] [b]Hit Chance:[/b] chance to hit with an ability. Is directly influenced by level difference between the character and the enemy. The higher the level of an enemy compared to the character, the lower the Hit Chance.
[*] [b]Crit Chance:[/b] Critical chance is influenced by the dominant stat for that class – Agility or Intellect.
[/list]

[b]Elemental Resistances:[/b]

All magic effects belong to a type of elemental magic. 
[list]
[*] [b]Fire Magic[/b]
[*] [b]Water Magic[/b]
[*] [b]Nature Magic[/b]
[*] [b]Arcane Magic[/b]
[*] [b]Death Magic[/b]
[*] [b]Light Magic[/b]
[/list]

Light and Death Magic are in direct opposition, with Death Magic wielders being especially weak to Light Magic and Light Magic wielders especially weak to Death Magic abilities.
Enemies weak to Fire Magic are also equally weak to physical Fire effects, like the Fire Arrow Ranger ability.
Elemental resistances mitigate a percent of the incoming damage from that specific element. Gear pieces with elemental resistance have values representing their elemental resistance. These values translate to different percentages of elemental resistance, depending on level, making a low-level gear piece more effective in elemental protection for the appropriate level character.



[b]Effects:[/b]

These effects are placed on the character by various abilities and can be temporary (only during combat) or permanent (must be removed either by resting, using a potion or in the Outpost). Each effect influences the player’s stats differently:

[list]
[*] [b]Sunder:[/b] can be applied by physical abilities. Decreases the player Armor and can stack multiple effects.
[*] [b]Wound:[/b] can be applied by physical abilities. Decreases the player [b]Initiative[/b] while active.
[*] [b]Bleed:[/b] can be applied by physical abilities. Deals damage over time to the character until removed.
[*] [b]Stun:[/b] can be applied by any kind of abilities. Locks the character in the current position in the combat queue for its duration.
[*] [b]Poison:[/b] can be applied by Nature abilities. Decreases [b]Hit Chance[/b].
[*] [b]Disease:[/b] can be applied by Nature abilities. Decreases [b]Agility[/b] and [b]Intellect[/b].
[*] [b]Curse:[/b] can be applied by Death abilities. Decreases [b]Strength[/b] and [b]Magic Armor[/b].
[/list]

These effects do not show on the Character Stat sheet but in the abilities description for each ability that places a certain effect. Some enemies can be immune to certain types of effects, making the abilities that place those effects less effective. This immunity will be shown in the Compendium entry for each enemy.

[b]Stats influence on abilities:[/b]
The power of each ability of a certain class is affected by a main stat. Because of this, different builds for a class can benefit from a different main stat.

As an example, below some of the Kingsman’s abilities and the stats affecting their power:
[list]
[*] [b]Strength:[/b] Basic Attack, Vanquish thy Foe, Avenger Strike, Bash of Wrath
[*] [b]Agility:[/b] Shield Wall, King's Resolve, Deflect, Hold the Line, Avatar of Protection
[*] [b]Intellect:[/b] Magic Absorption, King's Fire
[/list]


[b]Fatigue:[/b] is a special stat, central to the Fatigue and Outpost recovery mechanic. We will introduce more details on this mechanic in a dedicated post, at a later date.

Together with the Stats update we are also introducing new stats to armor and weapons.

[b]Durability:[/b] all weapons and armor now have a certain durability that decreases with each combat. Once a gear item’s durability reaches 0, that item is no longer usable and provides no contribution to the character’s stats.

[b]Armor Types:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Light Armor:[/b] worn by Wizard, Necromancer and Priest classes.
[*] [b]Medium Armor:[/b] worn by Ranger, Thief, Bard classes and the Captain.
[*] [b]Hardened Armor:[/b] worn by the Ranger, Kingsman, Lancer, Battle Cleric classes and the Captain.
[*] [b]Heavy Armor:[/b] worn by the Kingsman and Lancer classes.
[/list]

[b]Weapon Damage and Spell Damage:[/b]
[list]
[*] All weapons now have a weapon damage stat. This damage is added to the base attack of the character using that weapon.
[*] Specific caster weapons, like the staff, have a Spell Damage stat instead of Weapon Damage.
[/list]

There are any more changes coming to Armor and Weapons, but we will detail those systems in our next Developer Log, that will focus on gear and the Crafting System.

notes.title: Update 0.3.5 coming June 29th
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers of Zoria,

With all the great feedback we have received from you following the Prologue launch, we now have ready an update that introduces a number of changes and additions to the game, aimed mostly at quality of life and other issues and requests.

[b]This update will go live Monday, 8AM PDT. [/b]

Unfortunately, due to the extensive interventions we have made on the game, [b]the existing saves are not compatible with this update[/b]. We are aware this might be unpleasant for a number of players but, weighting the pros and cons we think it’s better to make all these updates available to everyone.

This incompatibility is due to extensive changes made to the database and the interactions system powering the game.

Below a list of the major updates and fixes:

[b]Updated Combat UI:[/b] a consistent update to the combat UI, with far more information for the player: Line of Sight indicators for all enemies in range when moving to a new position, on the ground indicators for motion range and AP consumed, available abilities when moving to a new position and many more small improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/cb7704cfbe9f015f3244f1a807b607bb8de6bf44.png[/img] 

•	Hovering the mouse over the battlefield will show the Action Points consumed for moving to that position and the enemies in line of sight from that position.
•	The abilities shown above each enemy will be grayed out if the character will not have enough resources to use them once in position.
•	Hovering the mouse over the character will show the enemies in line of sight from the current position and the abilities available to use. The abilities can be selected either with the mouse or with the number keys 1-9.
Based on feedback we also implemented click-to-move by default and also, clicking on an enemy that is in range will attack that enemy with the default attack.

[b]Formations:[/b] Another very popular request, formations are now fully implemented in the game. There are 4 fixed formations and 3 completely custom formations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/e88eec02454f333f042444374ff19f6753ad3044.png[/img]

In the formations screen, the Captain is always in the center, as a fixed position. 
For the fixed formations, the followers can be distributed in the available slots, but the slots are fixed.
For the custom formations, all the slots except the Captain slot can be moved freely, allowing the player to make any kind of setup desired. 
 
[b]Updated Compendium:[/b] Improve Bestiary, with a more granular representation of all the enemies encountered in-game. After the first combat with a new enemy, the information is unlocked in the bestiary part of the Compendium, with some lore about that type of enemy and important data about fighting that enemy – Strengths (physical, magical resistances), Weaknesses and Threat level.
All enemies encountered in the game are now represented in the Compendium.

[b]Fixed multiple issues in quest-design:[/b] we have fixed a number of quest events that in certain edge case situations would not trigger properly. 

[b]Fixed multiple UI issues:[/b] we have made small changes to the UI based on existing feedback, fixed a few minor bugs and made some small changes to improve readability.

[b]Text edits and fixes:[/b] we fixed some typos that managed to escape proofreading in the previous builds.

[b]Encounters balancing:[/b] we have decided to take another look at the Guardian encounter and balance the fight to be more accessible and fix some unavoidable damage that could one-shot a follower. Since difficulty levels are not yet implemented, we have rebalanced this fight to be more accessible to players of all skill levels, allowing everyone to see the entire Prologue.

With all this said, there is still much feedback from you that is being worked, together with the rest of the systems still to be introduced to the game - Crafting, Alchemy, Cooking and the whole Outpost base and followers management system.


If you enjoy this Prologue, come follow us here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159090/Zoria_Age_of_Shattering/

If you like the game and want to follow its development, you can also join our Discord:
 
[url=discord.zoriagame.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/19d7859b4b198674e9889887d5720324d8ae3470.jpg[/img]
[/url]

Formations: Another very popular request, formations are now fully implemented in the game. There are 4 fixed formations and 3 completely custom formations.

Updated Compendium: Improve Bestiary, with a more granular representation of all the enemies encountered in-game. After the first combat with a new enemy, the information is unlocked in the bestiary part of the Compendium, with some lore about that type of enemy and important data about fighting that enemy – Strengths (physical, magical resistances), Weaknesses and Threat level.
All enemies encountered in the game are now represented in the Compendium.

tags.bug: Fixed multiple issues in quest-design: we have fixed a number of quest events that in certain edge case situations would not trigger properly.
Fixed multiple UI issues: we have made small changes to the UI based on existing feedback, fixed a few minor bugs and made some small changes to improve readability.
Text edits and fixes: we fixed some typos that managed to escape proofreading in the previous builds.

tags.balance_change: Encounters balancing: we have decided to take another look at the Guardian encounter and balance the fight to be more accessible and fix some unavoidable damage that could one-shot a follower. Since difficulty levels are not yet implemented, we have rebalanced this fight to be more accessible to players of all skill levels, allowing everyone to see the entire Prologue.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 is now LIVE
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We want to thank you all for the awesome feedback we received in these past few days. Based on this feedback we implemented a number of changes to the game, aimed mostly at quality of life and other small issues that could be fixed in a timely manner.

[list]
[*] Adjusted Captain’s resistance to poison to prevent him from being destroyed by the spiders in the caves.
[*] “New skill points” display error on level up has been fixed. Now properly displays “New stat points”.
[*] A few spelling errors than went undiscovered during testing have now been fixed .
[*] Some quest dialogues that were not as clear as we would have liked them to have been adjusted.
[*] Fixed an issue with the order in which the enemies were entering a combat, causing them to be higher up in queue than designed.
[*] The special resource used by the followers has been unified under one name: Focus.
[*] Followers keep basic movement formation when entering the combat. More formations options will be implemented later.
[*] Anya/Emonora higher starting level (3/4) to make the experience in the dungeon more enjoyable.
[*] Fixed Area-of-Effect targeting for some enemies.
[*] Updated Health Bar UI to green for friendly and red for enemy units.
[*] Fixed chest pickups not opening sometimes when the player was too close to them.
[/list]

Some changes on this list are only visible with a New Game, because of the way saving works.

More changes are coming, and we did not forget about the local map, we're working to bring that as soon as possible.
There are many more things that were pointed out to us in your feedback, some take more time to implement or are downright design issues that will take some time to be ironed out, but we are taking everything into account, so expect more changes in the future.
